acceptance_rows: R1 In cmd_run_card, immediately after the e2e launch returns (pass or fail), recompute post = inv_hash(inventory(tree)); if post != tree_hash, re-run scope_verify on the fresh inventory against the parent inventory; any path outside allowed_paths sets cs['status']='FAILED' with reason 'E2E_TREE_MUTATED' recorded in cs and result-manifest.json and the card is not marked E2E_PASS; if only allowed paths changed, cs['tree_hash'] and result-manifest.json tree_hash are updated to post before status is finalized.

R2 cmd_review card branch recomputes inv_hash(inventory(tree)) and, if it differs from cs['tree_hash'], prints a single line starting with TREE_HASH_MISMATCH <card-id>, records no acceptance, changes no parent state, and exits nonzero; REVISION in the packet is always the recomputed hash.

R3 run_e2e.py gains scenario O43 with two parts: (a) a card whose e2e argv is python3 -c writing a file outside allowed_paths inside the tree; run-card must end FAILED with reason E2E_TREE_MUTATED and review --card must refuse (nonzero). (b) a card that passes e2e normally, then the scenario appends a byte to a file in the job tree before review; review --card must exit nonzero with TREE_HASH_MISMATCH and parent_hash must be unchanged.
R4 No change to e2e sandboxing, launch(), base_env, or any scenario other than O43.
objective: Re-verify the job tree after the e2e command runs so a mutated tree is never stamped with a stale tree_hash or accepted (F2)
stop_condition: print CARD_BLOCKED C2 if scenario id O43 already exists in e2e/run_e2e.py, or if cmd_run_card does not compute tree_hash via inv_hash before the e2e launch as described in the finding
